Title: Dizzy With No Headache? The Real Triggers Behind It

Description:
Vestibular migraine can cause vertigo and nausea without any head pain in roughly half of episodes. Research points to three everyday triggers behind the pattern: sudden weather and pressure shifts, skipping meals or not drinking enough water, and loud, visually crowded spaces like grocery stores and malls.

Watching the forecast on high-pressure-change days, keeping regular mealtimes with water nearby, and wearing noise-cancelling headphones in loud spaces cuts down how often these episodes strike.
